CustomField.description: Staging mirror routed to GiftCommitment.FQS_Skip_Naming__c on commit. When TRUE, the FQS Auto Name Gift Commitment flow skips the resulting GC record and leaves Name as-is. Paired with FQS_GT_Skip_Naming__c on the transaction side — Salesforce enforces one GiftEntry source field to one destination field per FieldMappingConfig. Use for imports or integration writes that carry an authoritative external Name.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Check to prevent the FQS auto-naming flow from overwriting the Name on the resulting Gift Commitment.
CustomField.label: Skip FQS Auto Naming (GC)
